## Assignment: Inventory Management with Stock Validation Duration: 1 Hour Frontend: Vue 3 Backend: Java (Spring Boot) OR Golang Database: MySQL OR PostgreSQL ## Objective Build a Mini Inventory Management System where: • Admin can add products • Users can view products • Users can place orders • Stock must reduce after order placement • System must prevent ordering more than available stock ## Section 1: Database Design (10 Marks) ## 1. Create the following tables: *Table 1: products*
Column Type Constraints
id Primary Key Auto Increment
name Varchar Not Null
price Decimal Not Null
stock_quantity Integer Not Null
created_at Timestamp Default Current Time
Table 2: orders Internal --- | Column | Type | Constraints | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | id | Primary Key | Auto Increment | | product_id | Foreign Key → products(id) | Not Null | | quantity | Integer | Not Null | | total_price | Decimal | Not Null | | created_at | Timestamp | Default Current Time | ## Section 2: Backend Development (40 Marks) You must implement the following APIs: A) Add Product POST /api/products Request: { "name": "Laptop", "price": 50000, "stock_quantity": 10 } Response: • 201 Created • Proper error handling --- GET /api/products Response: [ { "id": 1, "name": "Laptop", "price": 50000, "stock_quantity": 8 } ] C) Place Order (Critical Logic) POST /api/orders Request: { "product_id": 1, "quantity": 2 } Mandatory Business Rules 1. If stock_quantity < quantity o Return 400 Bad Request o Message: "Insufficient stock" 2. On successful order: o Deduct stock o Insert record in orders o Calculate total_price = price × quantity 3. Must use Database Transaction o If any step fails → rollback ! Additional Requirements nternal --- • Proper status codes • Proper error response format • Validation (no negative quantity) • Clean folder structure • Business logic should NOT be inside controller ## Section 3: Frontend (Vue 3) (25 Marks) Create a simple UI with: ## Page 1: Product Management • Add product form • Product listing table ## Page 2: Place Order • Select product • Enter quantity • Submit order • Display success/error message ## UI Expectations • Clean layout • API integration using Axios • Basic validation • Display updated stock after order ## Section 4: Edge Case Handling (10 Marks) System should handle: • Ordering non-existing product • Ordering zero/negative quantity • Concurrent order attempt (basic handling awareness) Internal --- • Proper status codes • Proper error response format • Validation (no negative quantity) • Clean folder structure • Business logic should NOT be inside controller ## Section 3: Frontend (Vue 3) (25 Marks) Create a simple UI with: Page 1: Product Management • Add product form • Product listing table ## Page 2: Place Order • Select product • Enter quantity • Submit order • Display success/error message ## UI Expectations • Clean layout • API integration using Axios • Basic validation • Display updated stock after order ## Section 4: Edge Case Handling (10 Marks) System should handle: • Ordering non-existing product • Ordering zero/negative quantity • Concurrent order attempt (basic handling awareness) Internal --- • Invalid JSON body ## Section 5: Code Quality & AI Usage (15 Marks) Candidate must submit: 1. Project folder (Backend + Frontend) 2. README file including: o Setup instructions o AI tools used o Prompts used (copy paste) o Any debugging done manually ## Bonus (Optional - 5 Marks Extra) • Add DB index • Add Swagger/OpenAPI Internal
